# --- Created 2026-08-03 (Will-approved). Founding measurement: 17 shared scripts; invocation is BIMODAL, not thin — safe-push cited in 39 protocol docs and ledger_staleness in 16, while TWO load-bearing checks were cited in NO executable step at all. PAT-071 one layer over: A CHECK WITH NO INVOCATION SITE IS UNOWNED IN PRACTICE, whoever wrote it.

# --- State tokens (local canon; BLUEPRINTS/STATE_VOCABULARY.md has no class for invocation state — registry extension owed): WIRED = cited as an executable step in >1 protocol · WIRED-SINGLE-INVOKER = exactly one protocol invokes it · WIRED-HARNESS = fired by .claude/settings.json, not a doc · UNWIRED = no executable step anywhere · MANUAL-BY-DESIGN = deliberately on-demand · SETUP-ONLY = machine provisioning · NOT-A-CHECK = tool, registered so the count is honest.

# --- SCOPE (widened 2026-08-17, Will-approved W2, self-audit F10): repo-root `scripts/` PLUS any agent-local check whose owner's boot does NOT invoke it — the original exclusion predicate ('invoked by their own owner's boot') was measured FALSE for DAEDALUS's own scripts (1 of 4 boot-invoked). An agent-local check with a real boot invoker stays OUT; one without is exactly PAT-071's unowned-in-practice class and belongs here. First instance: the 4 DAEDALUS-local rows below.
Surface	Owner	Owner_provenance	Enforcing_mechanism	State	Gap	Last_reviewed	Notes
